# Toggle Group

> A row of toggle buttons that Tab reaches once, with one pressed at a time or several.

`<slab-toggle-group>` · Selection · built on `[role=group]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/toggle-group/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/toggle-group.js';
import 'slab-elements/toggle-group.button.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-toggle-group label="Alignment">
  <slab-toggle-group-button value="left" pressed>Left</slab-toggle-group-button>
  <slab-toggle-group-button value="center">Center</slab-toggle-group-button>
  <slab-toggle-group-button value="right">Right</slab-toggle-group-button>
</slab-toggle-group>
```

Each item is a Toggle Group Button. The group sets each one's `aria-pressed`, so there's no ARIA to write.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                                                                                     |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Space, Enter | Presses the focused button, or releases it. Unless `multiple` is set, pressing one releases the rest.                            |
| Left, Right  | Moves to the previous or next button, wrapping and skipping disabled ones. Up and Down instead when `orientation` is "vertical". |
| Home, End    | Moves to the first or last button.                                                                                               |
| Tab          | Leaves the group. Coming back, focus returns to the button focused last.                                                         |

## Elements

### `<slab-toggle-group>`

Import `slab-elements/toggle-group.js` to register it.

A group of toggle buttons with no visual styles: a `[role=group]` around its Toggle Group Buttons, so Tab reaches the group once and the arrow keys move between them.

A click, Space or Enter presses a button or releases it. Only one is pressed at a time unless `multiple` is set, so pressing one releases the rest, and when more than one is pressed anyway, the last one stays pressed. The group sets each button's `aria-pressed`, so set `pressed` on one that starts out pressed and leave the ARIA to it. A click your own handler cancels doesn't press anything.

Buttons are found by class rather than by tag name, so your subclass of Toggle Group Button can be named anything.

Exactly one button is tabbable: the one most recently focused, or the first that isn't disabled. Left and Right, or Up and Down when `orientation` is `"vertical"`, move focus between them, wrapping at each end and skipping disabled ones, and Home and End go to the first and last. Moving focus doesn't press anything. In a right-to-left page, Left and Right swap.

`disabled` disables every button, and buttons added while it's set. Taking it off enables them again, even one that was disabled on its own before.

Style it through its part, and the buttons through their `:state(pressed)` and `:state(disabled)`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type                         | Default        | Description                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`                     |                | Names the group.                                                                      |
| `disabled`         | `boolean`                    | `false`        | Disables every button in the group.                                                   |
| `multiple`         | `boolean`                    | `false`        | Lets more than one button be pressed at a time.                                       |
| `orientation`      | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Which arrow keys move between the buttons. Where they sit is still up to your styles. |

#### Properties

| Name                         | Type                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `buttons` (read-only)        | `ToggleGroupButton[]` | Its Toggle Group Buttons, in order.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `pressedButtons` (read-only) | `ToggleGroupButton[]` | Pressed and enabled buttons, in the order they appear.                                                                                                                                         |
| `value`                      | `string`              | The value of the first pressed and enabled button. Setting it presses the button with that value, and only that one.                                                                           |
| `values`                     | `string[]`            | The value of every pressed and enabled button, in the order they appear. Setting it presses the buttons with those values, and only those, or only the first of them unless `multiple` is set. |

#### Methods

| Signature                             | Description                                     |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description |
| --------- | ------------------- | ----------- |
| (default) | `ToggleGroupButton` |             |

#### CSS parts

| Name    | Description |
| ------- | ----------- |
| `group` | The buttons |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description          |
| ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled. |

### `<slab-toggle-group-button>`

Import `slab-elements/toggle-group.button.js` to register it.

A toggle button with no visual styles. The host is the button, so style it directly.

There's no native `<button>` inside it. Its Toggle Group moves focus between its buttons with a roving `tabindex`, which has to be on the element that takes focus, and a button in a shadow root can't be reached from outside it. So the host is the button, with the role, `aria-pressed` and the keyboard of one: Space and Enter click it.

Its group presses and releases it, and it sets its own `:state(pressed)` and `:state(disabled)`.

#### Attributes

| Name       | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label`    | `string`  |         | Names the button when what's in it doesn't, such as when it holds only an icon.                                                                              |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                                |
| `pressed`  | `boolean` | `false` | Like a native checkbox's `checked`, the attribute is the default state and the property is the current one. Style `:state(pressed)` rather than `[pressed]`. |
| `value`    | `string`  | `''`    | What its Toggle Group's `value` and `values` hold while it's pressed.                                                                                        |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                                                                            |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `input`  | `Event` | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.   |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                                             |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The label, plus anything else a design puts in a button |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description          |
| ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled. |
| `:state(pressed)`  | While it's pressed.  |
